problem_statement: Redraw and improve the PP-VI-ReID motivation figure. The previous generated layout had oversized labels, crowded lower regions, and the bottom two panels used similar colors. The new figure must keep the original PPA-style visual language while making the layout camera-ready and balanced.
existing_weakness: Coarse anonymization creates inconsistent RGB/IR perturbations and Mixed Gap. Static anonymous images are not secure representations. Key protection can entangle identity and security cues, causing ReID discriminability collapse unless features are disentangled.
method_summary: Use the attached reference image only as style reference. Create exactly three horizontal panels stacked vertically, with clear equal-height allocation and consistent margins. The canvas must not crop any text or object. Use compact Times-like serif labels, avoid oversized headers, avoid long sentences, and leave enough whitespace between arrows, icons, and labels. Panel (a) should use a blue border and light blue diagonal hatch. Panel (b) should use a gold border and light gold diagonal hatch. Panel (c) must use a clearly different green border and light green diagonal hatch, not gold/yellow. Do not use the same dominant color for panels (b) and (c). Keep the panel captions inside the upper-left of each panel, not as huge centered titles. Required content: (a) 'Precise & Consistent Anonymization': RGB/IR images, coarse or inconsistent anonymization, red 'Mixed Gap', red crosses for broken contours/fine-grained cues, green checks for preserved clothing texture / pose structure / shared structure. (b) 'Key-Controlled Security': anonymous image is not secure, red cross for unauthorized use/privacy leakage, key-controlled gate with lock/key, authorized recovery, verifiable secure representation with shield and green check. (c) 'Utility-Security Disentanglement': key-protected features enter a disentanglement block, split into 'Utility Identity Features' and 'Security Key Features', avoid red feature conflict, output stable VI-ReID retrieval and secure protection. Make panel (c) visually green-themed and distinct from panel (b). No global title, no bottom caption, no duplicate panels, no generic downstream task, no text/document/NLP elements.

contributions.name: Key-controlled secure representation beyond anonymous image

figure.title: Motivation
figure.objective: Optimize the layout of the PP-VI-ReID motivation figure. Exactly three stacked panels, each with balanced internal spacing and no cropped or overflowing text. Panel (a) blue: precise and cross-modal consistent anonymization, Mixed Gap, broken contours/fine-grained cues, preserved shared structure. Panel (b) gold: anonymous image is not secure representation, key-controlled authorization and verifiability. Panel (c) green: utility-security feature disentanglement after key protection; do not color panel (c) like panel (b). Use the original PPA motivation figure style: diagonal hatch background, hand-drawn borders, dashed separators, Times serif labels, red problem labels, green checks, lock/shield/person/feature icons. No global title or caption.
figure.data_source: User layout optimization request and attached original PPA motivation figure

evidence_summary: Conceptual motivation figure, layout-optimized with distinct color themes for panels (b) and (c).
